scraper.code:
function listPosts({url,$}) {return {posts:$('article header h3 a').toArray().map(e=>({url:$(e).attr('href'),title:$(e).text()})),next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const b=$("[itemprop=\"articleBody\"]").first().clone(); b.find('script,style,nav,.related-posts,.post-navigation,.post-meta,.blog-posts,.upvote-button,form').remove();return {title:$("article h3").first().text().trim(),bodyHtml:b.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||null,tags:[]};}
scraper.notes: 本站首頁 article header h3 a 文章連結；單篇 article h3 標題、[itemprop="articleBody"] 正文。
